### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | Root directory of one isoseq run (01_PBCCS/ to 09_GSTAMA_MERGE/, ULTRA_INDEX/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/) |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | Optional design table (TSV or CSV): sample id in the first column (or a column named sample), one column per factor. Enables the design filters and the group card. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Design table sample-id column (links join on it). Auto-detected as the first column; defaults to 'sample'. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Design column the dashboards group and filter by. Auto-detected as the first factor column of METADATA_FILE. |
| `REFERENCE_GTF` | — | Reference annotation the isoforms are classified against (GTF with gene_id, transcript_id and optionally gene_name). Defaults to the GTF uLTRA indexed; pass it for a minimap2 run. |
| `SKIP_MULTIQC` | — | Set (--var SKIP_MULTIQC=true) for a run with --skip_multiqc: no report, so the MultiQC collection is pruned. |

**Auto-detected** (set from the run's metadata / `params.json`; the route flags drive *Conditional routes* below): `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY`

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`isoseq/insert_length.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/isoseq/insert_length.py) | FLNC insert length distribution per sample, from ``isoseq refine``'s per-read report. | `sample`, `length_bp`, `reads`, `pct`, `cumulative_pct` |
| [`isoseq/refine_summary.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/isoseq/refine_summary.py) | Full-length read yield of ``isoseq refine`` per library: FL, FLNC and FLNC with poly(A). | `sample`, `library`, `fl_reads`, `flnc_reads`, `flnc_polya_reads`, `chimeric_reads`, `pct_flnc`, `pct_polya` |
| [`nf-core/isoseq/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/isoseq/recipes/samples.py) | Sample hub for nf-core/isoseq: one row per sample, the read funnel and the transcriptome. | `sample`, `libraries`, `zmw_input`, `ccs_reads`, `ccs_pass_pct`, `fl_reads`, `flnc_reads`, `flnc_pct`, `collapsed_reads`, `collapsed_pct`, `median_insert_bp`, `isoforms`, `genes`, `annotated_genes`, `fsm_pct`, `novel_isoform_pct`, `novel_read_pct` |
| [`pbccs/zmw_outcomes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/pbccs/zmw_outcomes.py) | Where every ZMW of a library went in CCS: passed, or the filter that removed it. | `sample`, `library`, `rank`, `outcome`, `zmws`, `pct_of_input` |
| [`pbccs/zmw_yield.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/pbccs/zmw_yield.py) | CCS yield per library: how many ZMWs went in and how many became HiFi reads. | `sample`, `library`, `chunks`, `zmw_input`, `zmw_passed`, `zmw_filtered`, `pct_passed`, `too_few_passes`, `poor_snr`, `draft_failures`, `other_filtered` |
| [`tama/category_composition.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/tama/category_composition.py) | Structural category composition per sample, by isoform and by read. | `sample`, `level`, `structural_category`, `count`, `pct` |
| [`tama/genes.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/tama/genes.py) | Genes of the TAMA merge transcriptome: how many isoforms each carries, and how novel they are. | `gene_name`, `sample`, `gene_status`, `isoforms`, `read_support`, `dominant_isoform_pct`, `top_category`, `novel_isoforms`, `fsm_isoforms`, `ism_isoforms`, `nic_isoforms`, `nnc_isoforms`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `gene_id` |
| [`tama/polya_tails.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/tama/polya_tails.py) | Poly(A) tail lengths TAMA trimmed from the FLNC reads, per sample. | `sample`, `tail_length`, `reads`, `pct` |
| [`tama/transcript_blocks.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/tama/transcript_blocks.py) | Exon blocks of the TAMA merge isoforms, beside the reference isoforms of their genes. | `transcript_id`, `gene_id`, `gene_name`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `feature`, `strand`, `transcript_class`, `sample`, `expression` |
| [`tama/transcripts.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/tama/transcripts.py) | The TAMA merge transcriptome: one row per isoform, its read support and its class. | `transcript_id`, `gene_name`, `sample`, `structural_category`, `exon_structure`, `read_support`, `transcript_length`, `exons`, `junctions`, `known_junctions`, `chrom`, `start`, `end`, `strand`, `ref_transcript_id`, `source_models`, `gene_id`, `tama_gene_id` |
